title: Deeper/broader ACIS carrier, peer-writer, and native-consumer evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and local plan update
scope: Refresh current ACadSharp released reader and open ACIS writer branch status
Reconcile LibreDWG's reported R2013+ AcDs silent-loss scenario
Assess ezdxf and stock FreeCAD as bounded carrier/control and consumer routes
Refine the existing ACIS/AcDs implementation-ready checks without changing local work cadence

method.kind: Read current official project release, documentation, issue, and pull-request pages and reconcile evidence limits with the existing plan
method.limitations: Evidence is limited to mutable project documentation and release/issue/PR reports. ACadSharp and LibreDWG reports were not reproduced; no peer source, artifact, proprietary drawing, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was run. No DWG/DXF byte-layout changes are proposed; the ODA specification remains authoritative for implementation.

sources.revision: v3.6.51 release and merged PR #1154 reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Release notes list ACIS payload reading for 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY plus full Prototype1b parsing. The PR describes the section reader as low level and says schema mutation/reconstruction remains insufficiently understood. Its discussion includes a 423-DWG comparison and identifies record-alignment, stale-index, and section-failure edge cases. This supports an exact-revision comparison and adversarial test design, not general reader qualification.

sources.project: ACadSharp ACIS writer and schema work
sources.observed: PRs #1150, #1240, and #1174 are open. PR #1150 includes contributor-reported TrueView/ODA checks, but its October discussion states the branch conflicts with the schema refactor and reports the DXF reader then retaining only the last group-310 payload chunk. The maintainer says the writer may be redesigned around the new schema. Issue #1195's reported silent omission is against 3.4.9 and does not establish behavior for later releases.

sources.revision: Issue #1411 opened 2026-09-02; reports LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit prefix 8a1ae764
sources.observed: The report describes an ezdxf-generated AC1032 DXF REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB payload and a real R2018 drawing where the entity survived but AcDs geometry did not. It is a version/build-specific, unreproduced report and is used only to reinforce the silent-loss detection case.

The API can author/read SAT/SAB carriers and create ACIS bodies from meshes. The documentation states that unsupported ACIS structures are represented as NONE_ENTITY and lost, and that mesh projection only extracts flat polygonal faces, so curved-face interpretation requires an ACIS kernel. This is a scratch-control authoring/inspection route, not a complete ACIS oracle.

The documentation says embedded ACIS solids cannot currently be read by the stock DXF importer. This supports limiting stock-FreeCAD gates to 2D and explicit entities, with ACIS/B-rep qualification remaining a separate lane.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing S2.3.9.4.29/S8 evidence routing: use ACadSharp v3.6.51 only as a pinned optional read comparator; keep open writer branches out of released-peer claims until rebased and retested; assert full multi-group-310 and multi-record owner-key-payload closure; include silent external-AcDs loss detection; use ezdxf only to author scratch controls and FreeCAD only for its documented 2D/explicit-entity route. The local fast-slice gate, queue, and composed-only optional peer cadence are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin peer release, commit, build features, and input/output format/version before comparing; do not use an open writer PR as a released baseline.

For AcDs controls, include zero, one, four, and twelve records, multiple group-310 chunks, non-handle-sorted directory entries, stale index entries, and bounded malformed-section handling; derive expected layout from ODA and local literal vectors.
Assert source entity handle, physical owner, AcDs key/index, complete payload length/hash, and output disposition together; entity presence with empty modeler data is failure.
Use only scratch/in-memory generated controls, with independent analytic dimensions, units, topology count, volume, and centroid; do not commit external or newly generated drawings.
Keep DXF SAT, DXF SAB/ACDSDATA, DWG inline payload, DWG AcDs section writing, B-rep semantics, and native application acceptance as separate evidence cells.
Preserve the strict local fast target plus focused selector and owning CTest per slice; run one optional peer/native matrix at the existing composed gate only.
If an exact peer branch, native application, or payload profile is unavailable, record NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED and continue local implementation without promoting J items.
